coin.title: Finland 100 Euro “State Visits” Gold 2025 PF69
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HPV3FOF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A coin of demonstrable perfection in your collection? PF69 coins are nearly perfect, with superb detail and strong visual appeal. In this coin, any imperfections are tiny and barely noticeable. A beautiful piece that shines with exceptional quality: add the coin to your collection! Design The Finland 100 Euro 2025 “State Visits of Finland – Diplomacy and Foreign Policy was designed by Sinnika Inkeroinen-Huhta and Ilkka Huhta. The designers use a door to symbolize state visits and diplomatic relations between nations. Behind the door, negotiations take place, relationships are formed and the future is build. The obverse shows a glossy version of the door, with its surroundings roughly. The reverse shows the same door, but with a more roughly surface and a smooth and glossy surrounding.
